entries.submitted: Neutral building definition from incomplete design evidence (Building 001 sketch), proposed work class W9 and branch 'source-definition', plus a refinement: dimensions bind, proportions fill gaps, contradictions trigger a user question
entries.decision: Redirected to USG (gschmidtke/USG), the upstream repository. USG already owns this stratum: its AGENTS.md defines the same evidence classes (exact, derived, approximate, observed, ambiguous, unknown), docs/proposals/architectural-sketch-reconstruction.md holds the same sketch rule, and its inbox has a Building 001 review (2026-10-26). No W9 or new workflow value is needed in ARPL. ARPL keeps the downstream side: the USG -> ARPL handoff (acceptance invariants, approximate values not promoted to exact in Revit), to be filed as a pack once it has run in Revit. Raw files archived.

entries.submitted: Lessons from building a two-level concept model in Revit 2024 from a USG neutral spec via run_csharp: nine iterations, ten build rules (stage budget, idempotent writes, timeout protocol, type semantics, API version gate, dependency re-derivation, visual gate, evidence tags, intent-bearing settings, undo)
entries.decision: New technique, no existing pack covers a whole spec-driven build: filed as new pack ARPL-GEO-0004 rev 1 (W4, candidate, Revit 2024). The proposed failure pattern became FP40 (distinct from FP38: the code, not the environment, was wrong). FP22 extended with the write-call timeout evidence. Safety: no client data (contributor's own sketch), no secrets, no model files, no code to run, no text addressed to the curator.
